summary: Frontend-only test of whole-show grouping (Season, Specials and Extras folders) for multi-part cards. Used a simulated Electron bridge (electronAPI Proxy, library in sessionStorage 'fakeLibFile') with TMDB mocked. Every requested scenario passed. SUGGEST: The toolbar showed 'Multi-Part (2)'. Batman showed '7 files · whole show' with rows 'Season 1: Batman (2 parts)', 'Season 2: Batman.S02E01.mkv', 'Season 2: Batman.S02E02.mkv', 'Season 3: 03 - The Ogg Couple.mkv', 'Extras: Making of Batman.mkv', 'Extras: Bloopers.mkv'. Heat showed Heat (1995).mkv and 'Extras: Trailer.mkv'. Alien, Aliens and D:\Movies\Extras\Something.mkv were correctly NOT grouped. MERGE: The count went from 11 to 5 movies. s1 kept its id, title Batman, year 1966, poster /bat.jpg and tmdb_id, and now has 7 parts. Heat has 2 parts. The Multi-Part button disappeared after the merge. MODAL: Sections parts-section-season-1/season-2/season-3/extras are present. Only Season 1 is open by default (S01E01, S01E02). The toggles opened S02E01/S02E02, S03E03 (from '03 - The Ogg Couple') and Extra/Extra. Season 1 collapses on toggle. The play buttons opened the correct paths (Season 3 file, Making of Batman.mkv). SERIES INFO: Exactly these calls were made: /tv/5, /tv/5/season/1, /tv/5/season/2, /tv/5/season/3. There was no extras request. Episodes are S1E1, S1E2, S2E1, S2E2, S3E3 and the extras have no episode. Toast: 'Matched series "Batman" — 5 of 7 parts matched to episodes'. PLAY DIALOG: It shows the Season 1/2/3/Extras sections. Opening Season 2 and playing the last row opened Batman.S02E02.mkv, then the dialog closed. REGRESSION: The Green Planet Part 1..3 in a flat folder was still suggested ('3 parts'), merged, and labelled Part 1..3 with no sections. The single file Casino has no parts list. A Season 1 + Specials show was grouped too.

issues: A movie with an Extras folder (Heat) is labelled '2 files · whole show'. 'whole show' is misleading for a movie. Consider 'movie + extras' when the group has no season folders.
Specials (season 0) sort before Season 1 in both the suggestion and the merged list. Users usually expect Specials after the last season, next to Extras. This is optional.

action_items: LOW: Label movie + Extras groups differently from 'whole show'.
LOW (optional): Sort Specials after the regular seasons.
critical_code_review_comments: findPartGroups 'movie + extras' rule: any folder with exactly one loose movie plus an Extras/Trailers/Featurettes subfolder is grouped. Example: D:\Movies\OnlyOne.mkv + D:\Movies\Trailers\*.mkv would merge every trailer into that one movie. This is acceptable because the user confirms in the dialog, but consider requiring the folder name to match the movie's title or year.
SEASON_DIR also accepts a bare 's' prefix ('S1', 'S01 Extras' etc.). The trailing (?:\b.*)? means 'Season 1 Extras' is treated as season 1, not extras.

PartsList open state is initialised only once (useState initialiser). If the parts change while the modal is open (for example split or merge), the first section may not be open by default. This is minor.
Within the Extras section, files are sorted alphabetically (Bloopers before Making of) while the suggestion keeps the original order. This is cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: None in the DB. All seed data was in browser sessionStorage 'fakeLibFile' per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Harness: the init script sets window.electronAPI = Proxy(impl, unknown -> async () => null). IMPORTANT: isElectron must be a FUNCTION (() => true), not a boolean, otherwise App.js crashes. Other mocks: getLicense -> {subscription_tier:'free'}, getDrives -> ['C:\\'], listDirectory -> [], libraryReadSync/libraryWriteSync/libraryWrite via sessionStorage 'fakeLibFile', openPath pushes to window.__opened. localStorage: obsidian_cinema_eula_accepted='1.6.8', obsidian_cinema_skip_poster_tip='true', obsidian_cinema_tmdb_key='fake'. TMDB mock: page.context.route('https://api.themoviedb.org/**'). The library count is in the text '\d+ movies ·'. Open a modal by clicking its h3 title.
